title: Which guidance applies to Installing CloudBox Clients?

question.author: member_112
question.body: There seem to be different descriptions of installing cloudbox clients. What is the maintained CloudBox guidance?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Getting Started documentation says: CloudBox runs on the web, on Windows 10+, macOS 11+, Linux (since version 2.0), iOS 15+, and Android 10+. Install the desktop client for background sync, or simply use the web app in any modern browser — no installation required. All clients sign in with the same account, and files appear everywhere automatically. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
